<security_assessment>
<decision>SAFE</decision>
<details>
This file is a standard AUR .SRCINFO description for the "darkly" package, which is a fork of Lightly (a modern Qt application style). The content contains only normal packaging metadata: package name, description, version, release, URL, architecture, license, dependencies, build options, source URL, and SHA256 checksum. 

The source is fetched from the project's own GitHub repository over HTTPS (`https://github.com/Bali10050/darkly/archive/refs/tags/v0.5.40.tar.gz`), and a valid SHA256 checksum is provided (not SKIP). The dependencies are all standard KDE/Qt6 framework packages, and the build relies on cmake, which is ordinary for this type of package. There are no network requests beyond the expected source fetch, no obfuscated code, no dangerous commands (eval, base64, curl|bash in build context), and no unexpected file operations. The package build flow — fetching upstream source, running cmake, and installing into `$pkgdir` — is consistent with standard AUR packaging practices.

No evidence of injected malicious code, data exfiltration, backdoors, or supply-chain attacks was found. The file is consistent with a legitimate AUR package maintenance file.
</details>
